item.title: backlog history hardcoded tail -n 20 — no way to see more than 20 entries
item.intent: Users must be able to control how many history entries are shown; 20 is too low for projects with many completed items
steps: Locate cmd_backlog_history in aishore: tail -n 20 at end of jq pipeline (hardcoded)
Note that cmd_backlog_history currently rejects all arguments with 'Unknown option' error
Add --limit N flag (default 20) and --all flag to cmd_backlog_history
Use the parsed limit value instead of hardcoded 20 in the tail command; --all omits tail entirely
Update usage error message in the function to list the new flags
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: aishore backlog history shows 20 entries by default (backwards compatible)
aishore backlog history --limit 50 shows up to 50 entries
aishore backlog history --all shows all entries in the archive
aishore backlog history --unknown-flag prints error and exits non-zero
